# Stock Market Predictor API

The FastAPI back end of the Stock Market Predictor, a final-year research project
(Group C23, K J Somaiya School of Engineering).

- Interactive API documentation: `/docs`
- Health check: `/api/v1/health`
- Today's Morning Call: `/api/v1/morning-call`

This Space is filled automatically from the project's GitHub repository by the
"Deploy back end" workflow. Do not edit files here: change them on GitHub instead.

Educational project. Nothing here is investment advice.
